question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Asleep
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"asleep"** means in a state of sleep; not awake. (सोया हुआ)

 
 
• **Example:** The baby was fast **asleep** in her crib.
 
 
 
• **"Dormant"** refers to something that is in a state of rest or inactivity; temporarily inactive. (निष्क्रिय)
 
 
• **Example:** The volcano has been** dormant **for hundreds of years.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Dormant**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Drowsy** (उनींदा): Feeling sleepy and lethargic; half-asleep.

 
 
• **Example:** After a heavy meal, he felt drowsy and wanted to take a nap.
 
 
 
• **Dizzy** (चक्कर आना): Having or involving a sensation of spinning around and losing one's balance.
 
 
• **Example:** The ride made me feel dizzy.
 
 
 
• **Active** (सक्रिय): Engaging or ready to engage in physically energetic pursuits.
 
 
• **Example:** She leads an active lifestyle, jogging every morning.
 
 

 

2f:Tb2d,

The correct answer is: **Option 1.**&
